metadata.note: Values are pilot defaults with an evidence label in the decision log (D-xx). null = unresolved. Freeze a copy per experiment before Phase 7.

service.after_midnight_date_rule: rides after 00:00 belong to the previous service night (D-03)
service.rules_source: PROVISIONAL (earlier 20/25-minute discussion; not a verified Hopkins rule) (D-04)

fleet.shift_end_rule: stop new assignments at shift end; finish onboard riders

spatial.unknown_mass_rule: cut/hidden bubbles at lower bound, then margins scaled to the city-map fence ~24,056 (D-09)

travel.source: OSRM demo server, car, free-flow, retrieved 2026-09-29

simulation.commitment_rule: freeze the current road movement and all onboard riders
simulation.reassignment_rule: assigned-but-not-picked-up may be reassigned by B and C alike
simulation.end_of_night_rule: run until every accepted rider is dropped off

players.H: offline node-arc MILP with the whole hour known (ceiling; bracketed)

solver.name: HiGHS (highspy)
solver.delay_accounting_rule: decisions instantaneous in simulated time; solve time logged; solve > W flagged

calibration.throughput_target: completed rides per van-hour at 6 pm (~6.2)

evaluation.random_stream_scheme: per request id, pre-generated before any policy runs
evaluation.primary_metric: timely passengers served (wait and ride within limits)
evaluation.primary_comparison: C vs B at the same W; ladder N-A-B-C-H
